title: None can withhold what You give
cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said after every obligatory prayer, as al-Mughirah wrote to Mu'awiyah
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer, allaahumma laa maani'a limaa a'tayt, walaa mu'tiya limaa mana't, walaa yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd
translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the fortune of the fortunate is of no avail to him against You.
